title: 37 斗兽38 合成39 恶化
slug: 我有装备栏460上次那一位

不多时，又有一人进入场内。
一个青壮年，年龄差不多三十岁，身材魁梧高大，双手空空，步伐从容，给人一种经验老到的感觉。
此人的气势与刚才那个青年截然不同，宛若一名铁血猛士，不知害怕为何物。
而他的对手赫然是吊睛斑纹虎，两头！
“以一敌二！”
齐知玄挑了挑眉，咂舌道：“这人好勇啊！”
鲍怜花笑道：“他姓茅，外号茅十三，在斗兽场是一个老手。这场角斗是徒手生死战，茅十三必须杀死两头猛虎或者被杀死，角斗才会结束。”
话音刚落。
厮杀正式开始了。
两头吊睛斑纹虎似乎饿了几天了，直勾勾盯着茅十三，口水哗哗，目露凶光。
它们一左一右向前扑出，速度一快一慢。
茅十三嘴角一歪，裸露的身上浮现一条长蛇，他的身体随之匍匐在地，蜿蜒爬行。
左侧那头猛虎冲至，茅十三一个加速，贴地滑行，从猛虎身下穿过。
接着一跃而起。
这个瞬间，他身上浮现一头暴熊，狠狠撞向猛虎的腰部。
嘭！
老虎横移半米，侧翻在地。
茅十三大喜，快速骑到了猛虎身上，抡起拳头就打。
而他身上的暴熊已经消失，转变成了大猩猩，前肢力量强横，朝着虎头嘭嘭一阵乱拳暴捶。

“嗷！”
另一头猛虎绕到茅十三身后，一跃而起，扑了过来。
偷袭!
茅十三尽在掌握之中，身上立刻浮现白鹤，原地腾起，悬空三四米高。
猛虎扑了个空。
茅十三一个凌空，调转身体，头朝下，俯冲下来。
他身上的白鹤快速消失，又变成了一头鹿。
“鹿角冲撞！”
茅十三从天而降，一头撞向那头偷袭他的猛虎。
嘭！
巨大的冲击力将猛虎掀飞出去数米，滚了好几圈，卷起道道烟尘。
齐知玄目光闪烁，啧啧道：“我若没猜错的话，茅十三之所以叫茅十三，是因为他能够画出十三种猛兽，对吧？”

Not long after, another person entered the venue.
A young man, almost thirty years old, tall and tall, with empty hands and a calm pace, giving people a feeling of experience.
This man's aura was completely different from that of the young man just now. He was like a fierce warrior who didn't know what fear was.
And his opponent turned out to be an eye-catching striped tiger, with two heads!
"One against two!"
Qi Zhixuan raised his eyebrows and smacked his tongue: "This man is so brave!"
Bao Lianhua smiled and said: "His surname is Mao, and his nickname is Mao Shisan. He is a veteran in the Colosseum. This gladiatorial fight is a life-and-death battle with bare hands. Mao Shisan must kill two tigers or be killed before the fight ends."
The words just fell.
The fighting has officially begun.
The two dazzling striped tigers seemed to have been hungry for several days. They stared directly at Mao Shisan, drooling and looking fierce.
They pounced forward, one on the left and one on the right, one faster and the other slower.
The corner of Mao Shisan's mouth tilted, and a long snake appeared on his naked body. His body then crawled to the ground, crawling in a winding way.
The tiger on the left rushed over, and Mao Shisan accelerated, slid close to the ground, and passed under the tiger.
Then he jumped up.
At this moment, a violent bear appeared on his body and slammed into the tiger's waist.
Bang!
The tiger moved half a meter laterally and fell to the ground.
Mao Shisan was overjoyed and quickly rode on the tiger, raised his fist and hit it.
The violent bear on his body has disappeared and transformed into a gorilla. With powerful forelimbs, he punches and punches violently towards the tiger's head.
"Ouch!"
Another tiger came around behind Mao Shisan, jumped up, and pounced towards him.
Sneak attack!
Mao Shisan was under control, and a white crane immediately appeared on his body, soaring from the spot, hanging three or four meters high in the air.
The tiger pounced.
Mao Shisan volleyed, turned his body, and swooped down with his head down.
The white crane on his body quickly disappeared and turned into a deer again.
"Antlers Crash!"
Mao Shisan fell from the sky and slammed into the tiger that was attacking him.
Bang!
The huge impact pushed the tiger flying several meters, rolled several times, and rolled up clouds of smoke.
Qi Zhixuan's eyes flickered and he said: "If I guess correctly, the reason why Mao Shisan is called Mao Shisan is because he can draw thirteen kinds of beasts, right?"
